summary: Netanyahu declared Israel has severely degraded Iran's ability to harm it but vowed to overthrow the Iranian government and destroy Hamas, while the IRGC claimed a tanker attack in the Strait of Hormuz. The UN fact-finding mission accused the US of war crimes in strikes on Iran killing 178 civilians. Pakistan's interior minister travels to Tehran to discuss Houthi escalation as Saudi airstrikes hit Taiz, Yemen.
key_points: Netanyahu says Israel completed major mission against Iran and allies but will continue to overthrow Iranian government and destroy Hamas. (Source: @VahidOnline/78420)
IRGC Navy claims it targeted a Togo-flagged tanker in Strait of Hormuz, causing fire; UKMTO confirms incident, crew safe. (Source: @VahidOnline/78432)
UN fact-finding mission says US committed war crimes in two airstrikes on Iran, killing at least 178 civilians including 120 children at a school in Minab. (Source: @VahidOnline/78419)
Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi traveling to Tehran to discuss Houthi escalation in Yemen and regional security. (Source: @SharghDaily/184403)
Saudi airstrikes targeted Qasr al-Shaab roundabout in Taiz, Yemen, attempting to close road to Hawban. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/392873)
Israeli Air Force drone crashed off Palmachim beach due to technical malfunction; Navy recovered it, no information leak feared. (Source: @idf_telegram/25153)
US approved Saudi purchase of 48 F-35 jets after State Department review. (Source: @yediotnews25/135093)
Drone operated by Yemen's Third Military Region struck IRGC-backed Houthi vehicles. (Source: @shin_persian/10163)

sections.executive_summary: Netanyahu declared Israel has severely degraded Iran's ability to harm it but vowed to overthrow the Iranian government and destroy Hamas, while the IRGC claimed a tanker attack in the Strait of Hormuz. The UN fact-finding mission accused the US of war crimes in strikes on Iran killing 178 civilians. Pakistan's interior minister travels to Tehran to discuss Houthi escalation as Saudi airstrikes hit Taiz, Yemen.

points: IRGC Navy claimed responsibility for targeting a Togo-flagged tanker in the Strait of Hormuz with an unknown projectile, causing a fire on deck that was later extinguished; UKMTO confirmed the incident, reporting all crew safe and environmental impact unconfirmed. (Source: @VahidOnline/78432)

The UN Independent Fact-Finding Mission on Iran reported reasonable grounds to believe the US committed war crimes in two airstrikes during the conflict, killing at least 178 civilians, including over 120 children at the Shajarat Tayyiba school in Minab and 22 civilians in a tungsten penetrator strike on a sports complex and residential area in Lamerd. (Source: @VahidOnline/78419)

Netanyahu declared Israel has severely reduced Iran's ability to harm it but vowed to continue operations to overthrow the Iranian government, defeat its allies, and target "Palestine Corps" commanders inside Iran. (Source: @VahidOnline/78420)

Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi is traveling to Tehran to discuss Houthi escalation in Yemen and its regional security implications, amid reports Pakistan asked Iran to restrain Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia citing a 2025 bilateral defense agreement. (Source: @SharghDaily/184403, @asafroz/53547)
The Wall Street Journal reported Iran is struggling to bypass a maritime blockade with hundreds of trucks stuck at borders, indicating economic pressure. (Source: @kianmeli1/92215)

Six US Navy EA-18G Growler electronic-attack jets from VAQ-135 "Black Ravens" departed the Mediterranean after a six-month deployment, transiting with KC-135R and KC-46A tankers toward Lajes in the Azores. (Source: @shin_persian/10157)

Netanyahu stated Israel has completed the major part of its mission against Iran and its allies but emphasized the mission is not finished, vowing to destroy Hamas, overthrow the Iranian government, and continue operations against Hezbollah in Lebanon. (Source: @VahidOnline/78420)

Defense Minister Israel Katz affirmed the military campaign is ongoing with important goals against Iran and other fronts, focusing on stripping jihadi groups of territory, infrastructure, commanders, and replenishment capabilities in Gaza, Lebanon, and the West Bank. (Source: @VahidOnline/78420)

An Israeli Air Force remotely piloted aircraft crashed into the sea off Palmachim beach due to a technical malfunction; Israeli Navy sailors recovered the UAV and the IDF stated there is no fear of information leakage. (Source: @idf_telegram/25153)
Live mapping indicated warplanes heading toward Lebanon, suggesting potential aerial activity over Lebanese territory. (Source: @redlinkleb/43572)
The United States approved the sale of 48 F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia following a State Department review, enhancing regional air capabilities. (Source: @yediotnews25/135093)
Netanyahu warned Turkish President Erdogan that if he wants to help Hamas allies, he can invite them to Antalya but "will not set foot in Gaza." (Source: @VahidOnline/78420)

Netanyahu and Katz outlined a policy focused on depriving jihadi groups in Gaza and the West Bank of the ability to maintain territory, infrastructure, commanders, and replenishment, indicating continued intensive operations. (Source: @VahidOnline/78420)
Katz stated Israel is targeting "Palestine Corps" commanders in Iran to prevent Hamas rearmament, signaling a broader campaign beyond Gaza's borders. (Source: @VahidOnline/78420)
The Committee to Protect Journalists called on Israeli authorities to immediately release Press TV journalist Naqaa Hamed, highlighting press freedom concerns. (Source: @presstv/207306)

Israeli leadership declared the approach of degrading jihadi group capabilities has been implemented in Gaza and the West Bank, though no specific tactical operations were detailed in the current messages. (Source: @VahidOnline/78420)
Netanyahu vowed to continue Israeli operations against Hezbollah in Lebanon as part of the ongoing campaign against Iranian allies. (Source: @VahidOnline/78420)
Katz confirmed Israel has implemented its approach of degrading jihadi group capabilities in Lebanon, alongside Gaza and the West Bank. (Source: @VahidOnline/78420)
Live mapping showed warplanes heading toward Lebanon, indicating potential Israeli Air Force activity in Lebanese airspace. (Source: @redlinkleb/43572)
A drone dropped a bomb near a bulldozer in the town of Yater, Lebanon, without causing casualties, suggesting ongoing low-level hostilities. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/392866)
Artillery shelling was reported in Al-Qusayr, Syria, via live mapping, though the responsible party was not specified in the message. (Source: @redlinkleb/43619)
Iranian trucks are reportedly stuck at borders due to maritime blockade difficulties, per Wall Street Journal, affecting land supply routes through Syria and Iraq. (Source: @kianmeli1/92215)

No explicit Syrian or Iraqi government military developments were reported in the provided messages beyond the Al-Qusayr shelling and Iranian border logistics issues. (Source: @redlinkleb/43619, @kianmeli1/92215)
The Al-Qusayr area near the Lebanon-Syria border has seen artillery activity, potentially linked to broader regional operations targeting Iranian supply lines. (Source: @redlinkleb/43619)

Saudi airstrikes targeted the vicinity of Qasr al-Shaab roundabout in Taiz, Yemen, attempting to close the road between the city and Hawban, according to Houthi-aligned media. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/392873)
Early warning alerts were activated in Abha and Khamis Mushait, Saudi Arabia, indicating perceived aerial threats. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7202)
The United States approved the sale of 48 F-35 jets to Saudi Arabia after State Department review, significantly boosting Saudi air power. (Source: @yediotnews25/135093)

Pakistan's Army Chief Asim Munir reportedly asked Iran to restrain Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, citing a 2025 mutual defense agreement, and warned Pakistan may assist Saudi Arabia if the agreement's defense clause is triggered. (Source: @asafroz/53547)
A massive rally was held in Saada, Yemen, in support of the country's armed forces, demonstrating Houthi mobilization. (Source: @presstv/207317)
A drone operated by Yemen's Third Military Region struck vehicles belonging to IRGC-backed Houthi forces, indicating intra-Yemeni conflict dynamics. (Source: @shin_persian/10163)
Preliminary reports indicate a booby-trapped motorcycle explosion targeted a security center in Sanaa, Yemen, adding to the volatile security situation. (Source: @naya_foriraq/90891)

key_developments: Netanyahu declares Israel will overthrow Iranian government and destroy Hamas, stating Iran's ability to harm Israel "severely reduced" but mission incomplete; Katz confirms campaign continues against Iran, Hezbollah, and Hamas in Gaza, Lebanon, West Bank. (Source: @VahidOnline/78420)

IRGC Navy attacks Togo-flagged tanker in Strait of Hormuz with unknown projectile, causing fire; UKMTO confirms incident, crew safe, environmental impact unconfirmed; marks direct Iranian action against commercial shipping. (Source: @VahidOnline/78432)

UN fact-finding mission accuses US of war crimes in two strikes on Iran killing 178 civilians, including 120+ children at Minab school and 22 civilians in Lamerd tungsten penetrator attack; calls strikes indiscriminate. (Source: @VahidOnline/78419)

Pakistani Interior Minister travels to Tehran to discuss Houthi escalation; Pakistan Army Chief reportedly urged Iran to restrain Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, citing 2025 defense pact, warning Pakistan may intervene if Saudi activates mutual defense clause. (Source: @SharghDaily/184403, @asafroz/53547)

Saudi airstrikes hit Taiz, Yemen, targeting Qasr al-Shaab roundabout to cut road to Hawban; early warning alerts sound in Abha and Khamis Mushait; US approves 48 F-35 sale to Saudi Arabia. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/392873, @Faytuks_Network/7202, @yediotnews25/135093)

Israeli drone crashes off Palmachim beach due to technical malfunction; Navy recovers UAV, IDF says no information leak; warplanes tracked heading toward Lebanon; artillery shelling reported in Al-Qusayr, Syria. (Source: @idf_telegram/25153, @redlinkleb/43572, @redlinkleb/43619)

Yemen's Third Military Region drone strikes IRGC-backed Houthi vehicles; massive pro-Houthi rally in Saada; Wall Street Journal reports Iran's maritime blockade evasion failing with hundreds of trucks stuck at borders. (Source: @shin_persian/10163, @presstv/207317, @kianmeli1/92215)
sections.threat_assessment: The conflict is escalating on multiple fronts: Israel openly threatens regime change in Iran while conducting kinetic operations in Gaza, Lebanon, and Syria; Iran responds with maritime attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and supports Houthi operations against Saudi Arabia. The UN's war crimes allegations against the US introduce legal and diplomatic volatility.
